verdict.rationale: Asana ships its own AI agents (AI Teammates, AI Studio), so letting them plug in external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. However, the MCP evidence covers only Asana acting as an MCP server for outside clients such as Claude and ChatGPT, which is the server role and earns no credit here. The integrations directory's "context from other apps" for AI workflows is an adjacent feature, not documented MCP-client support.
